title: Saudi-Arabian Smoked Broccoli Tagine
description: A rich, buttery, and gooey smoky stew from Saudi Arabia featuring purple-sprouting-broccoli.
instructions: Heat the ghee or vegetable oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped broccoli and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the dried dates, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to a preheated smoker set to 225°F (110°C) and smoke for 30 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
Serve over couscous or rice, if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for later use.
